newsitem.title: UK: NWE/Med VGO steady on good crude but trade limited.
newsitem.headline: NWE/Med VGO steady on good crude but trade limited.

text.p: European VGO prices were held static on Friday by healthy crude futures but trade had been thinned out by weak supply and poor buying interest, traders said.
Continued healthy gasoline prices in the United States would help draw material trans-Atlantic, though European VGO surpluses were limited, dealers added.
One Spanish cargo was seen heading westwards after a mid-week deal.

German inland buyers were very relaxed, with one having bought some low sulphur barges early this week and happy to purchase more if they were available, but most others having no requirments until early to mid-June.
